data.one_liner: Detect screen lock and unlock events across Android and iOS platforms.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that enables your app to detect screen lock and unlock events across Android and iOS platforms. It provides native event callbacks and an event stream, as well as a way to perform manual status checks.
use_when: You need to pause sensitive activities when the screen locks.
You want to log out users or trigger background operations upon device lock/unlock.
You are building a mobile application for Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You need to test on simulators or emulators, as native system events are not available there.
You are targeting web, desktop, or other non-mobile platforms.
strengths: Supports both event streams and manual status checks.
Native event callbacks for both Android and iOS.
weaknesses: Does not work on simulators or emulators due to reliance on native system events.
Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. Test on physical devices as it does not function on simulators or emulators.
